beats.say: Emily McGonagle was an Essex lawyer before voicing the Netflix hit Spike.
The Guardian says she now plays eight characters in the animated series.
She records her lines from a large wardrobe in her family home.
With help from her husband Ciarán, she soundproofed the space for work.
Her voice also appears as 20 different characters in the Game of Thrones Kingsroad video game.
By trading legal papers for a microphone, she shows you can always change your story.
